_help: Site-wide configuration. Each field is documented inline. Edit through the admin editor.
_orderHandlerUrlNote: Google Apps Script Web App URL that receives bundle-builder orders. When empty, the form falls back to Formspree. See admin-help.html → How-to → Set up the order email handler.
_paypalClientIdNote: PUBLIC PayPal REST app Client ID (safe to expose). Loads the PayPal JS SDK on cart.html + donate.html. Leave empty to disable online card/PayPal payment (checkout falls back to record-only). The SECRET is NOT stored here — paste it into the Apps Script project's Script Properties as PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET. See docs/apps-script/paypal-setup.md.
_paypalModeNote: 'sandbox' (test money) or 'live' (real money). Must match the environment your paypalClientId + Script Property PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET belong to.
_currencyNote: ISO currency code used for PayPal charges and display.
_outreachCountriesNote: Fallback count of countries reached, shown before the live OutreachLocations backend loads. The authoritative list is managed in Content Studio → Outreach Map (getOutreachLocations).
biblesLanguagesMessage: Available in 2,000+ languages through our Gideon's International partnership
_biblesNote: Update biblesGivenAway manually via GitHub Actions or admin editor after each outreach. Stock counts synced from STW Order Ledger spreadsheet.
